name: Autonomous Agent Systems & Tool Orchestration
stats: 9 agent projects · 41 MCP tools · 11.7x Postgres speedup with approval-gated changes
content: Advaith builds agents with deterministic guardrails and human approval where it matters. Examples: SuperBrain MCP (41 tools, 8 memory types, private), a Postgres performance agent that diagnoses slow queries with EXPLAIN ANALYZE and, once approved, applies an index, benchmarks before and after, and rolls back if things get worse (11.7x on a 200k-row table), and a research verifier with a real human-approval pause.
